title: Maradona Goal of the Century - Víctor Hugo Morales commentary - Argentina-England 2-1 1986
summary: Victor Hugo Morales's famous radio commentary of Maradona's second goal against England at the 1986 World Cup. The emotional call is for many Argentines inseparable from the goal itself.
why: HN points to it as the best commentary of the goal, in Spanish, usually after Maradona's death or in discussions of remarkable goals.

quote.text: Best commentary of that goal is in Spanish
